name: Zaure Official Store
bio: This is our store — the one we check every morning before anything else. Featured products, hand-picked deals, and trusted services from across Nigeria, all in one place.

policies.returns: 7-day returns on any item that doesn't match its description. We cover return shipping.
policies.shipping: Nationwide delivery in 2–5 business days. Free shipping on orders over ₦50,000.
policies.warranty: Full buyer protection on every order placed through Zaure Official.

name: El
bio: El started with a simple idea: everyday things deserve to be made well. Shoe polish that actually protects. Shampoo that actually cleans. Products built for Nigerian leather, Nigerian hair, Nigerian weather. One name. Every detail.

policies.returns: 14-day returns accepted if the product is unopened and in original packaging.
policies.shipping: Dispatched within 24 hours. Delivery in 2–4 days across Nigeria.
policies.warranty: Every El product is guaranteed against manufacturing defects.

name: Teema Kitchenwares
bio: We're a small Kaduna family business that takes kitchenware seriously. Glass jugs that don't crack, cookware that lasts, and the everyday tools that make cooking easier.

policies.returns: Returns accepted within 3 days if the item arrives damaged. Send us a photo and we'll replace it.
policies.shipping: Careful packaging and hand delivery within Kaduna. Courier to Abuja, Kano, and Jos in 2–3 days.
policies.warranty: All glassware is inspected before dispatch. If anything arrives cracked, we replace it free.

name: Arewa Cloth House
bio: Northern Nigerian cloth house weaving and importing the fabrics that shape how our region dresses. Ankara, lace, adire, aso-oke, senator — everything a tailor, boutique, or wedding planner needs, direct from source.

policies.returns: Fabric can be returned uncut within 7 days for a full refund. No returns on cut fabric.
policies.shipping: Nationwide courier in 2–4 days. Kaduna hand delivery available.
policies.warranty: All fabrics inspected before dispatch. Colour-fastness guaranteed on traditional weaves.

name: Arewa Leather Works
bio: Handmade leather goods from Northern Nigeria. Belts, sandals, wallets, and bags cut, stitched, and finished by craftsmen — not factories. Every piece you buy supports a real workshop.

policies.returns: 7-day returns on unworn items in original condition.
policies.shipping: Hand delivery within Kaduna. Courier nationwide in 3–5 days.
policies.warranty: Real leather backed by a 6-month stitching guarantee. Free repairs on defects.

name: Kaduna Power Components
bio: Manufacturer of solar lighting and power accessories in Kaduna. Selling direct to shops, traders, and businesses who need reliable power that doesn't wait for NEPA.

policies.returns: 7-day returns on faulty items. We cover return shipping on defective goods.
policies.shipping: Nationwide dispatch in 3–5 days. Bulk orders get priority logistics.
policies.warranty: 6-month warranty on all solar products. Panels have a 10-year performance warranty.

name: Kaduna Agro Foods
bio: Food processor and agro supplier from Northern Nigeria. Groundnut oil, honey, sesame, hibiscus — sourced from local farmers and processed at origin.

policies.returns: No returns on food items unless tampered packaging or confirmed defect.
policies.shipping: Nationwide courier. Cold-chain not required for our oil and honey products.
policies.warranty: Every batch is quality-checked before dispatch. Report any issue within 48 hours.
